krill.sentenceEn: A global campaign has been launched to turn a huge tract of Antarctic seas into ocean sanctuaries protecting wildlife and banning not just krill fishing, but all fishing.
krill.translationZh: 一项全球性运动已启动，旨在将南极海域的大片区域划为海洋保护区，以保护野生动物，不仅禁止磷虾捕捞，还将全面禁止所有渔业活动。
krill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

krill.sentenceEn: One was created in the Ross Sea in 2016, another reserve is being proposed in a vast area of the Weddell Sea, and a third sanctuary is under consideration in the area west of the Antarctic Peninsula—a key krill fishing area.
krill.translationZh: 2016年在罗斯海建立了一个海洋保护区，另一个保护区提议在威德尔海的广阔海域建立，第三个保护区正在南极半岛西部海域——一个关键的磷虾捕捞区——进行审议。
krill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

krill.sentenceEn: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds".
krill.translationZh: 绿色和平组织的这项研究分析了该区域磷虾捕捞船的活动轨迹，发现这些船只越来越多地在“企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食区的紧邻范围内”作业。
krill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

krill.sentenceEn: Industrial fishing for krill (磷虾) in the unspoilt waters around Antarctica is threatening the future of one of the world's last great wildernesses, according to a new report.
krill.translationZh: 一份新报告指出，在南极洲周边未受污染的水域进行工业化磷虾捕捞，正威胁着世界上最后一片大型荒野的未来。
krill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

krill.sentenceEn: What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing?
krill.translationZh: 绿色和平组织的研究关于磷虾捕捞有何发现？

krill.sentenceEn: Many king penguins could no longer live on krill .
krill.translationZh: 许多王企鹅可能将无法再以磷虾为食。

keen.sentenceEn: We all know that infants are keen observers of the social world, but they're not just idly watching; they are tiny learning machines.
keen.translationZh: 我们都知道婴儿是社会世界敏锐的观察者，但他们不只是随意看看；他们是小小的学习机器。
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

keen.sentenceEn: She asked some very good questions about the position and the company, which made me think she is very keen about the job.
keen.translationZh: 她针对这个职位和公司提出了一些非常好的问题，这让我觉得她对这份工作非常感兴趣。
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

keen.sentenceEn: In an industry keen to slash labor costs and increase profits, further automation seems inevitable.
keen.translationZh: 在一个热衷于大幅削减劳动力成本并增加利润的行业中，进一步实现自动化似乎是必然的。

keen.sentenceEn: As any parent knows, small children are generally keen on screens.
keen.translationZh: 正如为人父母者所知，小孩子通常都非常喜欢电子屏幕。
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

keen.sentenceEn: I am, however, very excited about the prospect of joining this company and very keen to start from the bottom in whatever capacity I may be of use.
keen.translationZh: 不过，我对加入贵公司的前景感到非常兴奋，并且非常渴望从基层做起，尽我所能发挥作用。
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

keen.sentenceEn: Both candidates are very keen on getting the job.
keen.translationZh: 两位候选人都非常渴望得到这份工作。

kilometer.sentenceEn: In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral.
kilometer.translationZh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋探索公司（GME）总裁、打捞员鲍比·普里切特宣布，他在卡纳维拉尔角外一公里处发现了一艘沉船的散落残骸。

kilometer.sentenceEn: Nearly 64 kilometers of undeveloped beach and 648 square kilometers of protected refuge fan out from the cape's sandy shores.
kilometer.translationZh: 从卡纳维拉尔角的沙滩延伸出去的，是近64公里长的原始海滩和648平方公里的受保护保护区。

kilometer.sentenceEn: At 502,000 square kilometers , it can sometimes make recruiting staff a challenge.
kilometer.translationZh: 该地区面积达50.2万平方公里，有时会给员工招聘带来挑战。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

kilometer.sentenceEn: They are a technological leap, transporting iron ore along routes which run for hundreds of kilometers from mines to their destinations.
kilometer.translationZh: 这些自动驾驶卡车代表了技术上的巨大飞跃，它们沿着数百公里长的路线将铁矿石从矿山运往目的地。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

kilometer.sentenceEn: The 240 giant autonomous trucks in use, in the Western Australian mines, can weigh 400 tons, fully loaded, and travel at speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour.
kilometer.translationZh: 西澳大利亚州的矿场中，正在使用的240辆巨型自动驾驶卡车满载时重达400吨，行驶速度可达每小时60公里。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

kilometer.sentenceEn: It may be as deep as four kilometers .
kilometer.translationZh: 其深度可能达到四公里。

kindness.sentenceEn: The tradition dates back to colonial times when inns were few and far between, and the weary traveler had to depend on the kindness of strangers for a meal and a bed.
kindness.translationZh: 这一传统可以追溯到殖民时代，那时旅店寥寥无几，疲惫的旅行者不得不依靠陌生人的善意来换取一顿热饭和一张床铺。
kindness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

kindness.sentenceEn: Similarly, grateful people may be more likely to reciprocate(回报) with acts of kindness of their own.
kindness.translationZh: 同样，心怀感恩的人更有可能以自身的善举来回报他人。

kindness.sentenceEn: Of course, acts of kindness can also foster discomfort.
kindness.translationZh: 当然，善举也可能引发不适。

kindness.sentenceEn: Likewise, receiving a kindness can give rise to a sense of indebtedness, leaving beneficiaries feeling that they must now pay back whatever good they have received.
kindness.translationZh: 同样地，接受他人的善意也可能产生一种亏欠感，让受益者觉得自己必须回报所得到的一切好处。

kindness.sentenceEn: For example, if people feel they are not worthy of kindness or suspect that some ulterior(别有用心的) motive lies behind it, the benefits of gratitude will not be realized.
kindness.translationZh: 例如，如果人们觉得自己不配得到善意，或者怀疑善意背后隐藏着别有用心的动机，感恩所带来的益处就无法实现。

kindness.sentenceEn: He had done a small deed of kindness .
kindness.translationZh: 他做了一件小小的善事。

known.sentenceEn: Whatever the case, the next known instance of the Tree That Owns Itself being mentioned wasn't until 1901 in the Centennial Edition of that same paper, the Athens Weekly Banner.
known.translationZh: 无论如何，有关“自拥其树”的下一次记载要等到1901年，在同一家报纸《雅典每周旗帜报》的百年纪念版中才再次提及。

known.sentenceEn: This crowd mentality is strong enough for people to evade their known responsibilities.
known.translationZh: 这种从众心理足以让人们逃避他们明知的责任。
known.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

known.sentenceEn: This new tree became known as The Son of the Tree That Owns Itself and it was assumed that, as the original tree's heir, it naturally inherited the land it stood on.
known.translationZh: 这棵新树后来被称为“树主之树之子”，人们认为，作为原树的继承人，它自然继承了它所站立的土地。

known.sentenceEn: The genetic code of all 1.5 million known species of animals and plants living on earth will be mapped to help save species from extinction and boost human health.
known.translationZh: 地球上所有150万种已知动植物的遗传密码将被绘制出来，以帮助拯救物种免于灭绝并促进人类健康。
known.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

known.sentenceEn: Potential problems related to data sharing should be made known to and discussed by all participants at the beginning of a joint research project.
known.translationZh: 在联合研究项目开始时，所有参与者都应了解并讨论与数据共享相关的潜在问题。

known.sentenceEn: He is well known to the public.
known.translationZh: 他在公众面前非常知名。
